<!-- pr-reviewer: 1e632f50b38642ae54e42ebd5e81cb6765bd471c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (docs/process only; one renumber and one confirmation noted below).

**What looks good**
- Diff is 5 files, all process/docs (AGENTS.md, PR-reviewer.md, work-issue SKILL.md, PROCESS_VERSION, `docs/decisions/920-placement-rules.md`). No code, no xtask, no Cargo changes, so nothing to build.
- Merges cleanly with current `upstream/main` (trial merge-tree, no conflicts).
- Rules are concrete and checkable: the app-scope rule gives a mechanical test (the new file's `use` lines must name the ECS world, project file, command, MCP or CLI - five things, matching the list); the crate-edge rule names the exact trigger (a `camcraft-*` line in `[dependencies]`/`[dev-dependencies]`), the required decision-entry contents and the fewer-than-five-items cutoff; the test rule says where a file goes and what its Gate map must name.
- Consistent with #921/#972/#967: those PRs move tests into owner crates, name the real crate in Gate maps, add no crate edges, and #972's `origin_approach` reads motion source by file-system path rather than importing it - exactly the "read a recorded file / no new edge" shape the rule asks for. The corrected `crates/app/tests/` line and the `camcraft_post::post::engine` example match that. I found no contradiction with existing AGENTS.md text (Gate map wording at "Testing", layering, 400-line law).
- Reviewer checklist and work-issue skill name the same three rules; the second commit fixed the earlier "six"/five miscount.
- Body complete: `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #920`, decision file present, conventional subjects.

**Local results**
Not built (docs only). `git diff --stat upstream/main...` confirms no file outside the five above. No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependency changes.

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. PROCESS_VERSION: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` on main is 16; this PR sets 17. Open process PRs already hold 17 (#965), 18 (#967), 19 (#972) in a stack, and #930 holds 16. So this PR collides with #965; whichever of the two merges second takes the next free number. If it merges after the stack, it should be 20. Fine to renumber at merge per AGENTS.md; the body's reference to "#963" for the collision is out of date (it is #965).
2. The "fewer than five items" clause is flagged in the PR as the maintainer's to confirm; it should be confirmed (or reworded) before merge.
3. The quote "high cohesion, low coupling, because every gate is costly" is attributed to the maintainer, 2026-11-11; I cannot verify it from the PR - the maintainer should confirm it is verbatim, since AGENTS.md quotes users literally.
4. "Lowest crate that provides everything it imports" relies on the reader knowing the crate order; the layering is not spelled out in the rule. Optional: add one line listing it (geometry -> cl/tools -> motion/sim/post -> app).
5. The announcement on #681 is owed when this merges, with the final PROCESS_VERSION number.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 1e632f50b38642ae54e42ebd5e81cb6765bd471c -->
Independent review (docs-only, read from the diff; nothing built).

**Needs the maintainer's confirmation:** the PR wrote this sentence into AGENTS.md "Code shape" (rule 2): "An edge that would carry fewer than five items is not added: the caller passes the value in. (The wording of the five-item clause is the maintainer's to confirm.)" It is included, so this PR waits for you to confirm or change that clause. Apart from that it is ready.

**What looks good**
- Exactly the three rules from #920 are in; the fourth ("a new test joins an existing suite") is left out and the decision file says why.
- Each rule is short and checkable from a diff: new test file -> lowest crate that provides its imports, Gate map names that crate; a new `camcraft-*` line in `[dependencies]`/`[dev-dependencies]` needs a `docs/decisions/` entry with the items, why the caller cannot pass the value in, and what rebuilds; `app` code must read or write the ECS world, project file, a command, MCP or the CLI.
- The "Testing" line that called `crates/app/tests/` "app + commands" is corrected to "tests of what `crates/app/src` defines", consistent with the new rule. Nothing else in AGENTS.md was rewritten.
- PR-reviewer.md and the work-issue skill name the three rules; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is bumped.

**Required step (not a blocker):** PROCESS_VERSION is 17 here; main is at 16 and other open process PRs also take 17. Merge main and take the next free number when this lands. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- The PR body says "one of those six things" in a quote, but AGENTS.md says "five things" and lists five (ECS world, project file, command, MCP, CLI). The file is right; only the body is off.
- "Each future subcrate carries its own tests inside its crate (M4.1)" in "Testing" is now dated wording next to the new rule; fine to leave.
- The AGENTS.md rule says "`camcraft_post::post::engine`" as the example Gate-map name; make sure that path exists, otherwise pick a real module.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
